description: A React component for a draft persona review page, including UI for editing identity, skills, experiences, avatar upload, and navigation to skill validation.

classes.name: SkillChip
classes.description: Component displaying a skill tag with optional remove button

classes.name: TextInput
classes.description: Reusable text input component with label

classes.name: ExperienceCard
classes.description: Component for displaying and editing a key experience

classes.name: WorkStyleInsight
classes.description: Component for displaying work style insights

classes.name: SuccessToast
classes.description: Component for showing save success message

classes.name: DraftPersonaPage
classes.description: Main React component for the draft persona review/edit page

methods.name: onPickAvatar
methods.description: Handles avatar file selection, validates image type, creates object URL, and triggers animation

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current edits into persona state and persists via setDraftPersona

methods.name: confirmAndContinue
methods.description: Persists latest edits and navigates to /skill-validation

methods.name: updateIdentity
methods.description: Updates professionalIdentity fields in persona state

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Updates a specific career highlight in persona state

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to skills list if not duplicate

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from skills list
